prompt: Implement BankService.transfer(fromId: Int64, toId: Int64, amount: Int64) against the supplied Account entity and Tinox DB APIs. Transfer a positive amount between two different existing accounts. Reject missing accounts, nonpositive amounts, identical IDs and insufficient funds by throwing. Both balance changes must commit together or both roll back on any operational/database failure, including failure of the second save. Use the annotation-driven transaction contract; do not implement a private in-memory database. Keep the public signature and entity mapping. Main.main is only a smoke entry point. Acceptance provisions a fresh real PostgreSQL database per submission with held-out balances and constraints, replaces Main.main, and independently inspects database state with psql. Building does not require the daemon; running the smoke program requires your own configured local database. Submit invokes the provisioned acceptance environment. On this compiler, ORM save aborts the process on a database error; acceptance checks rollback after disconnect for that case and does not require in-process recovery. Ordinary validation errors must throw.
